sources.fact: LBBD70/CM Gascoigne Business/Industrial Area is 6.7ha, 2,296 net dwellings and planning-permission-status not-permissioned.
Brownfield ownership-status is owned-by-a-public-authority; this does not identify the legal HMLR proprietor or title number.
CM supplies POINT (0.081302 51.528787) with blank geometry; point is not the allocation/red-line/title polygon.
2,296 is current Brownfield capacity evidence, not a consented-unit count.
Regulation 19 decision materials separately list CM Gascoigne Industrial Area allocation documentation.
Regulation 19 agenda confirms CM allocation provenance; site-allocation reference is not an application reference.
The adopted Local Plan provides residential-led mixed-use allocation context; policy allocation is not planning permission.
Development-plan status does not prove that industrial relocation, land assembly or residential phases have occurred.
Be First's Gascoigne material records continuing industrial history/context including the New England Estate; current-use context is kept distinct from future allocation capacity.
LBBD states all Brownfield Register sites require planning permission.
Council asset data can describe council land/property but is not substituted for exact HMLR title evidence in this candidate wave.
Planning Data geometry/coverage semantics prohibit converting a point and ownership category into exact parcel/title relations.

examples.result: CM remains not-permissioned at 2,296 net dwellings.
2,296 is allocation/Brownfield capacity, not consented units.
Public-authority ownership status is not converted to a named owner or HMLR title.
Current/legacy industrial-use evidence is not treated as proof the allocation cannot progress, nor as proof redevelopment has begun.
Allocation provenance is not converted into an exact current application reference.
Blank geometry is not replaced by the Gascoigne neighbourhood, New England Estate or a point buffer.
No industrial relocation or land assembly is assumed without executed current evidence.
Promotion remains zero until exact CM application/site/title relation and statutory overlays are verified.
